description: This file contains a unit test class 'LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest' that tests the LDAP synchronization service's functionality to delete local users who are no longer present in the LDAP server. It sets up different scenarios, mocks LDAP entries, and verifies that users are marked as deleted appropriately.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of LDAPSyncService in deleting local users who are no longer present in LDAP.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes fixture directory path before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Tests deletion of users who are removed from LDAP and checks for correct marking as deleted, including handling of duplicates.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Tests deletion handling when LDAP entries have duplicate usernames.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Tests deletion when LDAP fetch results include users with missing or malformed data.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates a mocked EntryCollection object containing LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Generates LDAP Entry objects from a list of usernames for test purposes.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entries with duplicate usernames to test deduplication and deletion logic.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entries where some entries are missing required attributes to simulate fetch failures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Set up the fixture directory path for tests.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Test case for deleting users removed from LDAP, verifying deletion and user count.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Test case for handling LDAP entries with duplicate usernames during deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Test case for handling LDAP entries with missing data (failures) during deletion.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked LDAP EntryCollection with provided entries and settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entry objects from a list of usernames for testing.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entries with duplicate user names for testing duplicate handling.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entries with incomplete data to simulate failed LDAP fetch entries.
